summary: Comprehensive testing of Finance Module with 7 tabs completed. All backend (21/21) and frontend tests passed. Features include Dashboard, Cashbook, Expense (accordion view), Budget (monthly tabs), Invoice, Outstanding, and Custom tabs (Notion-like). All Export to Excel functionality present.
critical_code_review_comments: All 7 tabs (Dashboard, Cashbook, Expense, Budget, Invoice, Outstanding, Custom) working correctly
Export to Excel functionality present on all tabs using xlsx library
Expense tab has proper accordion view - clicking category expands to show expenses inside
Custom tabs feature (Notion-like) fully functional - can create, delete, add data
All modals (Add Cash In, Add Cash Out, Add Outstanding, Add Category) working with proper form fields
Bank account tabs (Current, GST, Savings, Cash in Hand) functional in Cashbook
Monthly filter tabs (Jan-Jun) present in Budget tab with year selector
Category-based colored badges used throughout for visual distinction
Backend expense_routes.py properly implements all CRUD operations with auth checks
seed_data_creation: Test data from previous iterations: TEST_Client_Payment income entries, Anbarasan salary payment
context_for_next_testing_agent: Finance Module with 7 TABS fully tested. Dashboard: 5 KPI cards (Total Revenue, Payment Due, Outstanding, Total Expense, Profit), 4 Bank Account cards, 4 Quick Action buttons, Export Dashboard. Cashbook: Cash In/Out side-by-side tables, Account tabs, Month/Year filter, Add buttons. Expense: Category accordion view with 12+ categories, click to expand, + button to add expense inside category, Add Category button. Budget: Monthly tabs (Jan-Jun), Year dropdown, category cards with Total/Paid/Balance, click for details. Invoice: Invoice list with 5 entries, Create Invoice button, Export button, status badges. Outstanding: Add Outstanding button, table with Expected Date/Project Name/Type/Amount/Received/Balance, Record Payment for each entry. Custom Tab: + button to add, create modal, delete (X) button, Add Row/Add Data functionality. NO MOCKED APIs.
